name: draw-karo
description: Draw Karo — desi draw-and-guess party game (Android/iOS/Web)

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @drawkaro/shared && npm run build -w @drawkaro/words
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @drawkaro/server && node apps/server/scripts/e2e.mjs
scripts.test:restart: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @drawkaro/server && node apps/server/scripts/restart-test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @drawkaro/shared && npm run typecheck -w @drawkaro/words && npm run typecheck -w @drawkaro/server
